title: Windowed burst SLO forecaster and incident annotator
author: Aisha Kapoor
description: Background: Production customers observe short burst windows (10s-2m) that cause transient SLO violations and noisy paging. Motivation: reduce alert churn by surfacing predicted burst windows on dashboards and tagging incidents with a burst severity score so runbooks can use tuned mitigations. This PR implements a windowed burst SLO forecaster (sliding-window short- and medium-horizon predictors), a per-tenant burst severity metric, dashboard annotations for predicted windows, and an incident annotator that attaches burst context to PagerDuty/Slack alerts. The design is lightweight: forecasts are computed from rolling token-rate and latency histograms, score is normalized per-tenant using recent baseline percentiles, and predictions are emitted as sampled events to the tracing pipeline for enrichment. Changes include: 1) runtime: new metrics emission path for burst_score and burst_prediction events; 2) observability: Grafana panels and annotation overlay for predicted window ranges; 3) alerting: a library to attach burst context to outgoing incident webhooks; 4) ops: a Playbook document and a toggle (feature flag) to opt-out per-tenant. Rollout plan: feature-flagged on staging for 48h, canary to 5% tenants for 72h, full rollout after quality gates. Testing: unit tests for forecasting logic, integration test that injects synthetic bursts and verifies annotated events in traces, lightweight load runbook verifying no additional tail latency. See commit list and changed files for details.

review_comments: Diego Torres: Could we make the normalization window configurable per-tenant? Right now it's hard-coded to 1h which may not fit all workloads.
Aisha Kapoor: Good call, added a tenant.config.normalization_window and defaulted to 1h; updated docs.
Eliot Park: The dashboard annotation rendering looks noisy at small zoom levels; can we add a min-annotation-duration threshold so single-token blips don't show up?
Aisha Kapoor: Added min_annotation_duration=5s with an admin-config and unit tests covering aggregation behavior.
Samira Chen: Who owns the playbook? Need on-call steps for 'forecasted burst' vs 'observed sustained'. Also add a short blameless RCA checklist.
Aisha Kapoor: Playbook assigned to SRE rotation; added two paths and a short RCA checklist. PTAL.
Diego Torres: Integration tests flaked in first run due to timing; observed we needed a soft-retry in test harness.
Aisha Kapoor: Added a retry loop with jitter to the synthetic injection harness; reran CI and green.
release_notes: Add windowed burst SLO forecasting and dashboard annotations: new per-tenant burst_score metric, forecasted burst annotations in Grafana, incident enrichment with burst context, and an ops playbook. Feature is behind a feature flag and can be canaried per-tenant.
notes_for_ops: Feature flag: feature.obs.burst_forecaster (default off). To enable for tenant: set deploy/feature-flags.yaml or use console toggle. Watch metrics: burst_score (gauge), burst_prediction.lead_<10s|30s|60s> (counter) and dashboard annotation panel 'Predicted Burst Windows'. If paged for predicted bursts, follow docs/playbooks/burst-mitigation.md.
changelog_summary: Observed-noise reduction: adds short-horizon burst predictor, dashboard annotations, and incident enrichment to help on-call triage and reduce false-positive SLO alerts.
testing_notes: Unit coverage included for forecasting math with edge cases (zero traffic, constant high load). Integration test injects three synthetic burst shapes and asserts trace enrichment and annotation emission. Load-runbook verified no increased tail latency when forecaster runs at default 1s cadence.
author_response_summary: Addressed reviewer concerns: added tenant config for normalization window, min-annotation-duration, stabilized integration tests, and expanded playbook. CI reruns clean; ready to merge.
observability_impact: New metrics emitted (burst_score, burst_prediction.lead_*). Tracing ingestion receives sampled burst events for enrichment. Dashboard adds annotation overlays that are opt-in by tenant.
performance_impact: small CPU overhead: forecaster runs at 1s cadence by default with microsecond histogram lookups; measured ~0.4% CPU at 5% tenant canary in load test.
